Visitor: Do you have double rooms for about 28 people?

Visitor: (1) ______.

Visitor: Thank You.

Visitor: Great. Please (2) ______ the rooms for me.
Clerk: OK. Mr. Lin, (3) ______.

Clerk: The checking in time is 1:00 p.m.
